about: Fork arms of the Tier-1 fix (T1fix) experiments, as Hydra overrides appended to the forked item's own overrides (fork_train.py --arm). {name} fields are filled with --param name=value. A fork keeps the item's experiment, task, scene.support and reset.seed, and by default also the task-specific overrides of the stage that trained the pinned checkpoint (configs/items/<item>.json fork.inherit); an arm override replaces an inherited one with the same key. Every fork resumes from model_<N> plus rsi_<N> with training.early_stop_help_zero_tail=0 and training.max_iterations=<N + plus>.

C.note: Plain continuation (the control of every T1fix stage). Used for ep14 stage 1 (44922 -> 75000) and ep29 (24091 -> 39091, pinned 30000).

params.beta: rotation weight of object_task, exp(-beta * angle); the default is 1.0

B.note: Rotation-weighted object reward. Pinned items: ep10 beta 4.5, ep19 3.0, ep14 2.6, ep01 3.0, ep28 4.5. ep29 with beta 2.3 was not pinned (its plain control C was).

T.note: Tighter object-orientation termination. Tried on ep21 from C3r2_runin/ep21 model_47000 (stage 1); not pinned.

TB.note: T plus rotation weight 2.5. Tried on ep21 (stage 1, about +0.02 AUC); not pinned.

OP.note: ep28 wave 1 from ep28-B model_58000 to 68000: relaxed orientation, tighter position termination. Verdict FAIL (no MP-SR).

W2P.note: ep28 wave 2: position-only object reward after the final release.

W2PD.note: W2P plus the no-drop term after the final release. ep28 model_66000 (from ep28-B model_58000) is the set's episode 28.

G.note: Bat (ep04) wave 1, relaxed object and palm terminations. Built but never launched.
